comparison.objective: Separate a snap-together case into two halves.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual opposing grasp and straight pulling sufficient to disengage a tongue and spring plunger.
comparison.success_condition: Both halves are disengaged and remain at least 3 cm apart; pulling only one half is explicitly insufficient.
comparison.reason: Both regulate force around retained components, but this tests symmetric tensile separation of a reusable joint, not tool-mediated impact fracture and debris containment.
